text.name: Peso Bailout
text.rules: Record "rescue". LIO chooses: Attach conditions? If yes, LIO spends 2 points, then at the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point; if no, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: After the peso collapsed in December 1994, the United States and the IMF assembled a rescue package of up to $50 billion in early 1995, including $20 billion from the US Exchange Stabilization Fund; Mexico repaid the US loans by January 1997.
